items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The trombone player he got $10 and I got $15 and when he gave it to me, he got mad. That was George Washington.

ctx.x: He would pay musicians different things because different people were more important.
That's exactly right. The trombone player he got $10 and I got $15 and when he gave it to me, he got mad. That was George Washington.
If you work every night, seven nights, did you all do that quite often - work seven nights a week, seven different one-nighters?
